actions.invalidation: Close if BoC delivers or explicitly endorses a 2027 path consistent with CRAH27 holding at or above the 3.13 entry, or if Canada CPI-trim/median leave the packet 1.9/2.0 zone higher while employment/wages reverse the August -42k / +2.0% cooling. Close if CRAH27 implied rises toward CRAM27 3.365 rather than cheapening. A US-only SOFR selloff that leaves CORRA_2027-03 unchanged is not invalidation. Energy headlines without a core/labor break are not invalidation. No hedge: if the thesis fails, close.
actions.thesis: Duration-long / receive MX CRAH27 (paper alias CORRA_2027-03, family locked to CORRA/CRA). Packet mid implied_rate 3.13 / price 96.87. Long in this book is long duration with P&L inverted in implied-rate space: profits if Mar-27 implied CORRA falls from 3.13 toward the still-alive near-term path (1m Dec-2026 2.58, 3m Dec-2026 CRAZ26 2.775), not if Canada catches up to SOFR. The 2027 contract is where the unwarranted hiking cycle is concentrated; do not migrate onto SOFR, AONIA, CA-US 2Y, or USDCAD.
